question:
I have some sql models that gets refreshed. After the dbt run, there are some fields that gets updated outside of dbt [ a binary needs to be run and output of the binary is used to update the fields ]. I want to classify these tests using tags as post_binary. Now, my goal is to build the sql models and run all the tests other that post_binary during dbt build

models

  • model1
  • model2
  • run tests other than post_binary
  • run binary and output [outside of dbt]
  • run tests with tags post_binary

-- run dv
title: dbt build command and exclude specific tests
answer:
dbt run

do other external tasks, than:

dbt test --exclude tag:post_binary
